question.text: What is the maximum time period within which SEBI must provide its observations on a draft offer document?

answer.text: 15 days from the date of filing
45 days from the date of filing
30 days from the later of receipt, satisfactory reply to queries, regulator clarification, or in-principle approval
60 days from the date of filing with no conditions

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI may issue its observations within 30 days from the later of: (a) receipt of the draft offer document, (b) receipt of a satisfactory reply to SEBI's queries, (c) receipt of clarification from any other regulator or agency, or (d) receipt of a copy of the in-principle approval letter. The Trap: Simply saying "30 days from filing" is incomplete because the 30-day period runs from the latest of the four trigger events, not from filing alone. Note: All four trigger points under Regulation 25 must be considered when computing the observation timeline.
